name: Fanta
writeup:
Just like her namesake, Fanta is bubbly, refreshing, and guaranteed to brighten your day. This adorable gal is an easygoing pup who likes to keep life sweet and simple. She's kind, gentle, and gets along well with other dogs, making her the perfect addition to just about any home.

While we don't know much about Fanta's past, we're excited about the happy ending waiting in her future. Looking for someone to add a little extra fizz to your life? Fanta is the perfect blend of sweet, easy, and lovable. Pop the top on your next adventure and make this refreshing little girl part of your family!

Warning: Side effects of adopting Fanta may include excessive smiling, spontaneous cuddles, and wondering how you ever lived without your daily dose of sweetness.

Sweet miss Fanta joins us from Front Street Sacramento City Animal Services after she landed there as a stray. Due to their overcrowded shelter they sought placement for her in a senior specific rescue.

name: Snapple
writeup:
Snapple is proof that the best things in life only get sweeter with age. This extra-large Lab may be a giant, but she's a gentle giant. Snapple is the kind of dog who believes every day should be served chilled: a leisurely stroll, a cozy nap, a few snacks (quality control, of course), and good company. If your lifestyle is more "slow sip" than "energy drink," you've just found your perfect match.

Snapple gets along wonderfully with other dogs and has the kind of easygoing personality that makes everyone feel at ease. She is always ready to brighten your day with her sweet smile and soulful Lab eyes. If you've been searching for a supersized best friend with a heart just as big as his paws, Snapple is ready to pour herself into your life.

Snapple joins us from Front Street Sacramento City Animal Services after she landed there as a stray.

name: Kelpie
writeup:
Kelpie is a happy-go-lucky little guy with a smile that never quits and energy to match! He is pure energizer bunny! This scruffy sweetheart is full of charm, loves meeting new people, and is always ready to brighten your day with his cheerful personality. He's an active guy ready to join you on your next hike or whatever adventure you have in store.

Whether he's trotting along on a stroll or curling up for a cozy nap, Kelpie is simply happy to be by your side. If you're looking for a fun-sized best friend with a heart of gold, Kelpie is your guy!

Kelpie came to us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after his guardian could no longer care for him.

name: Blitzen
writeup:
What's not to love about a charming Dachshund? Blitzen is a friendly and social little guy. One of Blitzen's favorite pastimes is hanging out with other dogs. He's incredibly social, has excellent dog manners, and has always enjoyed making new four-legged friends. Whether it's a neighborhood stroll or hanging out with a canine companion, he's happiest when he has another dog around who speaks his language.

Like many Dachshunds, Blitzen also comes with a big personality packed into a little sausage-shaped body. He has significant resource guarding behaviors and has a bite history related to those issues. Because of this, he is looking for a very experienced Dachshund home -- someone who understands the breed, can recognize his boundaries, and is committed to managing his environment so he can be successful. He isn't a dog for first-time owners, but in the right home with knowledgeable guardians, Blitzen has tons of love and companionship to offer.

Blitzen enjoys being active but has also been quite the little escape artist in his day, so secure fencing and attentive supervision are essential. He prefers having his people nearby and would love a home where someone is around much of the time. Car rides aren't really his favorite, so he's happiest enjoying the comforts of home. He is also looking for an adults-only home who understands and respects his boundaries.

Blitzen joined POMDR after his guardian sadly fell ill and was no longer able to meet his needs.

name: Dr. Pepper
writeup:
Meet Dr. Pepper, a true original! Looking for a companion who's less high-energy soda and more warm cup on a rainy day? Then allow us to prescribe a healthy dose of Dr. Pepper. This distinguished senior gentleman has spent far too much of his life being passed around. What he's searching for now is simple: one forever family, one comfy bed, and one person to call his own.

Dr. Pepper is the definition of easygoing. He's perfectly happy with leisurely strolls, cozy naps, tasty treats, and someone to share the couch with. Life hasn't always been kind to this gentleman, but somehow he's kept his gentle heart intact. He's affectionate without being demanding, grateful for every kindness, and content just being near the people he loves.

This senior sweetheart joined us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after he was returned.

name: Mia
writeup:
Named after soccer legend Mia Hamm, this little Poodle mix is an all-around MVP. Mia is the kind of dog who seems to make friends wherever she goes. She's incredibly sweet, easygoing, and has that rare "just fits right in" personality. Whether she's joining you for a neighborhood stroll, curling up beside you after a busy day, or making fast friends with another four-legged pal, Mia is simply happy to be part of the team.

She's wonderful with other dogs, gets along beautifully with cats, and we think she'd likely be a fantastic match for a family with respectful children, too. Mia enjoys getting out and about. She's a great walking buddy, but she's just as content settling in for snuggles afterward. Affectionate without being velcro, she's always nearby for companionship while still giving you your space.

Mia came to us from the Los Banos Animal Shelter after being found as a stray, and it's hard to believe no one came looking for such a gem.

name: Messi
writeup:
Meet Messi! This sweet little black-and-white terrier mix may be small, but he has a whole lot of love to give. Like his soccer star namesake, Messi is a true standout -- gentle, kind, and sure to win hearts wherever he goes. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he feels comfortable, his sweet personality shines through.

Messi is cat-friendly! He would thrive in a loving home where he can relax, build confidence, and be someone's special companion.

Messi came to us from the Los Banos Animal Shelter after he was found as a stray.

name: Fifa
writeup:
Like a great soccer game, Fifa's life has been full of excitement. After being adopted from the Los Banos Animal Shelter, this sweet girl was diagnosed with bone cancer and had a leg amputated to give her a second chance. She is now cancer free, but she was returned to the shelter.

Now she's getting a third chance to thrive! She's still got plenty of spunk left. Not only is Fifa easy going, she is great with other dogs and with people too.

Fifa joined the POMDR family after the staff at the Los Banos Animal Shelter recognized her exceptional temperament and reached out to find her more appropriate placement.

name: Pocket
writeup:
Pocket is an adorable little gentleman with a big personality and an even bigger love for life! This charming senior is ready to steal hearts with his scruffy good looks, happy spirit, and his absolute favorite hobby: soaking up all the belly rubs he can get.

When Pocket is not busy being the cutest pup around, he's living his best life zooming across the astroturf and racing through the grass like a tiny four-legged superstar. Whether he's playing outside or soaking up attention from his favorite humans, this sweet boy knows how to have a great time.

If you're looking for a fun-loving companion who will bring endless smiles, silly moments, and plenty of cuddly charm into your home, this little guy might be your perfect match. He's ready to trade his playtime adventures for a forever family and a lifetime of love!

Pocket joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after his guardian lost their housing.

name: Strawberry
writeup:
Meet Strawberry, a sweet and lovable pup with a heart as bright as her name! This charming girl is ready to wiggle her way into your life with her gentle personality and adorable presence. Strawberry is the kind of dog who brings a little extra sunshine wherever she goes.

Strawberry is a wonderful companion who gets along well with other dogs and enjoys having furry friends around. She has a medium to low energy level, making her a great match for someone looking for a relaxed buddy who is happy to go for a stroll, share some snuggles, and enjoy the simple things in life.

If you're looking for a sweet-natured girl who will fill your days with love, loyalty, and plenty of tail wags, Strawberry may be your perfect match. She's ready to find her forever family and start her next chapter!

Strawberry joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after after her guardian lost their housing.

name: Puffin
writeup:
Tiny and full of charm, Puffin is a sweet little Yorkie looking for a soft place to land. This adorable senior has a gentle soul, a cute little tongue that loves to peek out, and a face that's impossible to resist. He's happiest soaking up attention, enjoying cozy naps, and simply being near his people. If you're looking for a pint-sized best friend to brighten your days, Puffin is ready to waddle right into your heart.

Puffin came to us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services after his guardian could no longer care for him.

name: Axel
writeup:
Axel is a handsome large-breed gentleman who has so much love to give. With his sweet personality, loyal nature, and lovable presence, he's the kind of dog who makes every day feel a little brighter. Whether he's soaking up attention, enjoying time with his people, or showing off his charming personality, Axel is ready to be someone's best friend.

This gentle giant is hoping to find a forever home where he can be loved, appreciated, and included as part of the family. If you've been searching for a devoted companion with a whole lot of heart, Axel may be the perfect match.

Big dogs have a special way of filling a home with comfort, companionship, and endless love. Axel is ready to prove just how wonderful a big-hearted buddy can be. Give this sweet boy a chance, and he just might become the loyal, loving friend you've been waiting for.

Axel joined the POMDR pack from Hitchcock Road Animal Shelter after he was picked up as a stray.

name: Froyo
writeup:
Did someone say Froyo? Yes, please! Just like his frozen yogurt namesake, Froyo is cool, comforting, and guaranteed to make you smile. This gentle boy has the kindest soul, the softest heart, and a calm, loving personality that makes him the perfect companion for cozy evenings, leisurely walks, and all the little moments in between. If you're looking for a best friend who will happily stay by your side, Froyo is your guy.

Froyo has a heart condition, which makes him a little extra unique and lovable, it just adds to the incredible dog he is. His heart may need a little extra care, but it's absolutely overflowing with love, kindness, and devotion. He's a beautiful reminder that the most special things in life don't have to be perfect.

If you've been dreaming of a calm, affectionate, and truly one-of-a-kind best friend, Froyo is ready to fill your days with love, snuggles, and plenty of sweet memories. This lovable boy just may be the perfect addition to your family.

Froyo joins us from Hitchcock Animal Shelter. Because of his heart condition, they felt he would thrive best with a senior rescue that could provide the specialized care and love he deserves.

name: Mako
writeup:
Mako is a playful and gentle soul searching for his forever home. At 12lbs, he's the perfect sized companion, and he loves sharing a bed with his person. He's estimated to be 6 years old and is still showing a youthful bounce!

He has picked up on training well, including basic obedience. He's great with other dogs and people. Despite being a sweet guy, his previous rescue struggled to find interest for him. After waiting a year for his forever home, he's joining the POMDR family to help the search! Will you be part of his happy ending?

Mako joins POMDR from Tiny Paw Pug Rescue, where he landed but his lack of Pug genes seemed to inhibit him from finding his forever landing spot. They reached out in hopes of finding him the right match of an adoptive home with a senior focused rescue.

name: Otter
writeup:
Like his namesake, Otter is happiest when he's close to the ones he loves. This sweet 10-year-old Chihuahua mix recently lost the only home he'd ever known after his beloved owner passed away. Through all of life's changes, Otter has remained the definition of a gentle soul. He's calm, affectionate, and gets along wonderfully with both people and other dogs, making him an easy companion to have by your side.

Otter has a few medical needs we'll be helping him with, but none of that slows down his sweet spirit. What Otter needs most is a soft place to land and someone to remind him that he's safe, loved, and home again. If you're looking for a loyal little companion with a heart full of love, Otter is ready to float right into yours.

Otter comes to us from the Monterey SPCA after his guardian passed away.

name: Tide
writeup:
Tide is a little ray of sunshine who's ready to make waves in your heart! Whether she's exploring the backyard, soaking up belly rubs, or curling up beside you for a cozy nap, Tide is happiest when she's with her people. She's the perfect mix of fun and snuggly, always ready for a new adventure or a quiet evening on the couch. If you're looking for a loyal best friend who will fill your days with smiles, laughter, and unconditional love, Tide is ready to roll right into your life!

Tide loves making new friends and is always excited to greet everyone with a wagging tail and a happy smile. Give her a toy, a comfy blanket, or a sunny spot to lounge in, and she's one happy girl. Every day with Tide is filled with little moments that remind you just how special she is.

She dreams of a family that will shower her with love, include her in life's adventures, and remind her every day that she's home for good. Whether it's neighborhood walks, weekend road trips, or simply relaxing together after a long day, Tide is ready to be your faithful sidekick through it all. She's eager to learn, eager to love, and even more eager to become someone's cherished companion.

Tide joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being brought to the shelter as a stray.

name: Cove
writeup:
Cove is a handsome gentleman with a heart as warm as a sunny shoreline. This sweet boy is all about good vibes, tail wags, gentle walks, soft pets, and tasty treats.

He's got just the right mix of playful energy and calm companionship, making him a great match for both adventure buddies and cozy-home loungers. Cove is curious, affectionate, and always ready to make your day a little brighter just by being in it.

If you're looking for a best friend who feels like a breath of fresh ocean air, Cove is ready to come home and make waves in your life.

Cove joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being brought to the shelter as a stray.

name: Wave
writeup:
Meet Wave, a sweet senior lady with a gentle heart and irresistible personality. Though her vision is limited, she navigates the world with quiet confidence and an open heart. She loves soft voices, kind hands, and the comfort of simply being near her people, soaking up affection wherever she finds it.

Wave is an easygoing, affectionate girl who enjoys the simple things in life - cozy naps, gentle pets, and calm companionship. She's the kind of dog who settles right into your space and makes it feel warmer just by being there. Friendly and loving, she greets new friends with a soft tail wag and a trusting spirit that shines through.

This golden girl is ready for a peaceful forever home where she can be cherished and cared for. Her vision impairment just means she appreciates a steady routine and a little guidance, but what she gives in return is pure devotion. Wave is ready to fill someone's life with quiet joy, soft moments, and unconditional love.

Wave joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being brought to the shelter as a stray.

name: Jackie
writeup:
Meet Jackie, a spirited senior girl with a heart as big as her personality. Don't let her age fool you; this girl still has plenty of pep in her step. She does equally well with a 20 minute sniff-n-stroll around the neighborhood as with a 3 mile hike. She is no slouch on trail and keeps up a good clip when she's in the mood. Jackie is great on leash and wonderfully responsive to treats.

Jackie gets periodic zoomies and adores an interactive play session with her people. The game is dealer's choice; tug (she will graciously keep shoving your end of the toy back into your hand), chase-and-be-chase, Wrestlemania, she's up for pretty much anything. She does use her mouth in a playful way when the game is afoot but is responsive to redirection. Her house manners are impeccable, housetrained, and OK being left home alone when necessary.

Jackie's feelings about other dogs vary. She lives very well with her part time foster sister - a street-smart senior Chihuahua and is relatively indifferent to most other dogs but she doesn't suffer fools and is not a fan of big, over-eager youngins. As a general rule, she seems to prefer small dogs to dogs her own size. She would love to play with the Chihuahua in the house, but her tactile, enthusiastic play style combined with the size differential and the Chi's age make it an unrequited love.

She is surprisingly easy on leash for such a big, strong dog, but will do best with someone comfortable handling her size and strength, especially during those moments when her inner puppy emerges. Jackie was reportedly crate trained in her previous home but is never crated in her foster home and is the perfect housemate. She made an amazingly smooth transition to her foster home and is primed to do the same for her adopters. If you're looking for a loyal, lively companion who's equal parts affectionate, self-contained, and adventurous, Jackie might be your perfect match.

Jackie joined the POMDR pack because one of her loving guardians has dementia and is moving into assisted living. Sadly, they can't take her with them. This sweet, silly girl is looking for someone to swoop in, scoop her up, and show her that she has many more years of love ahead of her!

name: Guppy
writeup:
Guppy is true to his roots, blending the energetic, playful spirit often seen in a Border Collie with the loyal, protective qualities of a Shepherd-type dog. He thrives when he has both physical activity and mental engagement in his day; whether that's a lively game of fetch, exploring new environments, or simply being your trusty sidekick on everyday adventures. He also has a softer side and enjoys winding down with his person, happily settling in for snuggles after a full day of fun.

Guppy is not considered a good fit for a feline household at this time, and any canine companions would need to be thoughtfully and carefully introduced to ensure a good match.

While Guppy is a calm, sweet dog most of the time, he has had his moments of aggression. X-rays revealed arthritis in his back, which may contribute to his handling sensitivity and reactivity toward men. He does have a bite history, biting a man twice after having his feet wiped and another time after being harnessed. He is now on medication, and he would benefit from an experienced handler and quiet home, preferably with only women.

Guppy came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Shelter after being found as a stray. He is now looking for a committed, experienced, and patient home that can continue to help him thrive while respecting his needs and boundaries. With the right understanding and structure, Guppy has so much potential, and he's ready for a person who can appreciate both his joy and his complexity.

name: Tino
writeup:
Have you ever known a dog who lets little girls dress him up and will wag his tail with genuine delight during "makeovers"? Well, allow us to introduce you to the incomparable Tino! This adorable boy might be a teensy shy at first, but he'll warm up quickly. Pets are Tino's love language. Because he's simultaneously mellow and affectionate, Tino's been deemed the "world's greatest dog" by his foster parent! He gets along well with other dogs, is a champ on a leash, and is fine spending time by himself, seeing it as an opportunity to enjoy a snooze. If you're headed out on a road trip, Tino would be a great wingman; he appreciates the windows down and his sniffer sniffing, or perhaps another nap while you drive.

The remarkably gentle and adorable Tino came to us from Santa Cruz County Animal Shelter where he was surrendered by his guardian with several other dogs.

Sponsored By: Chungyao Kao

name: Funyun
writeup:
Funyun is proof that the best things come in crispy little packages. This lovable senior Yorkie has been through more than his fair share of life's layers, arriving in our care with neglected skin and limited sight. (He's also likely deaf). But underneath it all is one incredibly sweet guy who simply wants a cozy bed, gentle pets, and someone to love.

Funyun is looking for a compassionate foster or adopter who can help him leave the past behind and enjoy all the comforts he's always deserved.

name: Phylo
writeup:
Meet Phylo: a sweet senior gentleman with a world-class nose
with a gentle heart, an easygoing nature, and one very impressive claim to fame: he is one of only 22 dogs in the nation to receive Master Elite certification in scent work through the SPCA!

In his foster home, Phylo has been an absolute delight. He is friendly with strangers, warms up quickly, and greets new people with quiet curiosity rather than barking or fuss. He is a loyal little shadow who enjoys following his people around the house, but he is not demanding. He is happy to be near you, beside you, or sometimes right on you.

Phylo loves affection and has an adorable way of asking for more: if you stop petting him before he is ready, he may gently place his paw on you to request an encore. He also enjoys being held and makes a wonderful companion for someone who wants a loving, connected dog.

For all his scent-work accomplishments, Phylo is a mellow guy day to day. He likes short, easy walks, which is appropriate for a 10-year-old dog. He enjoys car rides and settles well in the car when handled safely. At home, he sleeps through the night until you are ready to get up.

Phylo is house-trained and can also use a potty pad. He is slightly hard of hearing, but this does not seem to slow him down much. He prefers not to be left alone for long stretches, so he would be happiest with someone who is home often or can include him in daily life.

Phylo could be a great fit for many types of homes. He would love someone who appreciates a mellow, affectionate companion with a remarkable talent, a sweet soul, and a gentle paw-tap reminder that more pets are always welcome.

Phylo re-joined POMDR after his former guardian was sadly no longer able to care for him. Now he is ready for a new chapter with people who will love him for the special dog he is.

name: Onion Ring
writeup:
A tasty treat doesn't get much better than an onion ring! Our boy Onion Ring is full of pep, loves exploring, and is always ready to greet you with a wagging tail or trot alongside you for a stroll. He's the perfect blend of playful and easygoing, happy to join in on the fun before settling in for some well-earned cuddle time.

Onion Ring is a social little guy who gets along wonderfully with other dogs and absolutely adores people. Whether he's making new friends on a walk or curling up beside you on the couch, he's happiest when he's part of the action.

Onion Ring joined us from Hollister Animal Services. Due to his senior status and the approaching July 4th holiday expected to fill the shelters, they felt that he would do best with a senior focused rescue to find his forever home.

name: Fritter
writeup:
Sweet as her name, Fritter is a tiny Chihuahua with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. She may be a senior, but this little lady didn't get the memo! She's bright-eyed, spry, and always ready to tag along for an adventure or happily trot beside you on a neighborhood walk.
Fritter is as friendly as they come with her human friends. She adores people and has a cheerful, easygoing personality that makes everyone fall in love with her. She does prefer to be the only dog in the household. When the day winds down, Fritter is more than happy to curl up beside you for some cozy cuddle time. She's the perfect combination of playful companion and professional lap warmer.

Little miss Fritter joined us from Hollister Animal Services. Due to her senior status and the approaching July 4th holiday expected to fill the shelters, they felt that she would do best with a senior focused rescue to find her forever home.

name: McGruff
writeup:
McGruff is a happy boy with a bright, cheerful personality and a big love for life's simple joys. He's especially motivated by treats and toys, which are sure to win his heart and help him show off his playful side.

This sweet boy enjoys attention and companionship and seems to enjoy engaging with his people in a gentle, friendly way. With his soft nature and happy spirit, McGruff is the kind of pup who brings easy smiles wherever he goes. He'd love a home where he can enjoy affection, playtime, and plenty of cozy downtime with his favorite humans.

McGruff came to us from the Los Banos Animal Shelter after he was picked up as a stray.

name: Antoine
writeup:
Meet Antoine! In true Frenchie fashion, he's a boy with a big personality packed into a perfectly squishy little frame. This charming boy is the definition of Frenchie fun: equal parts silly, snuggly, and just a little bit dramatic in the most entertaining way. Antoine loves being close to his people but is also perfectly content hanging back at home if you need to run errands without him as your shadow.

This little guy brings a lot of heart, a lot of personality, and just the right amount of Frenchie flair to brighten any home lucky enough to have him. He's excellent with other dogs big and small, but is currently a bit overstimulated when meeting fellow canine pals. Until he is neutered, he may need to be kept solo to avoid upsetting his dog friends.

This sweet Frenchie boy came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being found as a stray with severe facial swelling. Due to concern for his medical needs, we expedited the process for Antoine to join us and get the care he needed in our vet clinic.

name: Mayo
writeup:
Meet Mayo, a black and white Chihuahua mix with a soft, easy charm and just the right amount of mellow sweetness to match his name. He has a gentle, observant nature and tends to take in the world quietly before settling in close to his person.

Mayo enjoys cozy spots, calm companionship, and the comfort of being near someone he trusts. He's the kind of little dog who becomes a steady, sweet presence once he feels at home.

Mayo came to us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after he was picked up as a stray.

name: Mustard
writeup:
Meet Mustard! She's got just the right amount of sweetness and spice to match her name. Small but full of personality, she has a soft, charming presence and that classic little-dog confidence that says she knows exactly how cute she is.

She's the kind of pup who's happiest nestled close to her people, soaking up affection, and being part of whatever's going on, preferably from a cozy lap or a sunny spot nearby.

Mustard came to us from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento after she was picked up as a stray.

name: Aloha
writeup:
Aloha is all about joy, energy, and good vibes! This playful pup lives for fun and will happily show off her signature zoomies when she's excited. Whether she's romping around the yard or chasing toys, Aloha brings a contagious enthusiasm that will keep you smiling.

She's also a social butterfly! Aloha does great with other dogs and loves meeting new people. Her friendly, easygoing nature makes her a wonderful companion for an active home or a family looking for a dog who can join in on all the fun. If you're looking for a happy, social pup who will fill your days with laughter and love, Aloha might just be your perfect match.

Aloha joined POMDR from Hitchcock Road Animals Services in Salinas after she was found as a stray.

name: Cody
writeup:
Meet Cody, a tiny gentleman with a heart as sweet as can be. Cody recently lost the person he called family and is now looking for a loving home where he can spend his golden years surrounded by comfort and care.

Cody is house trained, crate trained, walks nicely on leash, and gets along beautifully with dogs, cats, children, and new people alike. He's a calm, friendly little guy who is happiest relaxing near his people, taking short strolls, and enjoying a cozy spot to nap.

While he has age-related hearing and vision loss and would do best in a home without lots of stairs, Cody remains a gentle, affectionate companion with plenty of love left to give. If you're looking for a low-key best friend, Cody may be the perfect match.

Cody was surrendered to Peace of Mind when his guardian was no longer able to provide the care he needed.

name: Betsy
writeup:
Cute as a bug, sweet as a snuggle, and just waiting for someone to shower her with hugs and love. This precious senior pug has perfected the art of melting hearts with one look from her soulful eyes and adorable squishy face.

Betsy isn't looking for much, just a cozy bed, a warm lap, a few tasty treats, and a family to call her own. She's past the puppy chaos and all about the good stuff: cuddles, naps, companionship, and yummy treats!

Every day with Betsy is a reminder that the best things in life are soft, snuggly, and come with four paws. If you've ever dreamed of a tiny best friend who will happily binge-watch TV with you, keep your feet warm, and greet you like you're the most important person in the world, Betsy is your girl.

This sweet Pug came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being found as a stray.

name: Potato
writeup:
Potato is strikingly pretty, full of personality, and completely aware of both facts. Pink is her color -- she insists -- and she has a way of turning heads wherever she goes.

Her favorite things include cozy naps, car rides, leisurely walks, and spending time with her people. She bonds deeply with her family and loves being close, happily following her favorite person from room to room. Crate-trained, well-mannered, and easygoing, Potato would thrive with someone who works from home or is retired and appreciates a loyal, snuggly companion.

Potato is in great health, however, almost entirely deaf, and completely unbothered by it. Potato navigates the world confidently and very much on her own terms. She does have allergies and is currently thriving on prescription hydrolyzed protein food to help keep her feeling her best. Potato does have one firm request: she would like to be the only dog in the home. She's perfectly friendly with other dogs out and about, but she prefers not to share her house, her people, or her spotlight.

Potato joined the POMDR pack after her previous home was no longer the right fit for a fabulous queen like her. She originally arrived at a shelter around the time of the L.A. fires with little known about her history. If you're looking for a devoted companion with plenty of charm, affection, and a little bit of sass, Potato is ready to meet you.

name: Sparkler
writeup:
Meet Sparkler! Just like a warm summer evening filled with laughter, ice cream, and a little bit of magic in the air, Sparkler has a way of making everything around her feel a little brighter. Sparkler is easygoing, affectionate, and happy to take life at a gentle pace.

Sparkler gets along well with other dogs and brings a calm, friendly presence wherever she goes. With her fluffy coat, darling face, and soft, soulful eyes, she's impossible not to fall in love with.

Sweet Sparkler joined us after she was found as a stray and brought to Hitchcock Road Animal Services. They felt she would do best in a senior focused rescue to find her forever family.

name: Snorkel
writeup:
Pack your bags - Snorkel is ready for the trip of a lifetime! This adorable pup is searching for a forever family to be his favorite travel companions. With his sweet personality and easygoing nature, Snorkel is the kind of dog who makes every day feel like a vacation. Whether he's exploring new places or relaxing by your side, he's happiest when he's sharing the journey with people he loves.

A true social traveler, Snorkel gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is always happy to make new friends along the way. When it comes to cats, he's more of a "live and let live" kind of guy. He's generally indifferent and content to coexist peacefully. His friendly attitude and laid-back charm make him an easy companion for all kinds of friends.

Snorkel's dream itinerary includes cozy naps, plenty of belly rubs, and a one-way ticket to a loving forever home. If you're looking for a loyal sidekick to make every season feel like a getaway, this sweet boy is ready to stamp his paw print on your heart. All that's missing from his travel plans is you!

Snorkel joined the POMDR pack from Los Banos Animal Shelter after being picked up as a stray.

name: Brisket
writeup:
Brisket is a fluffy bundle of charm with a heart as warm and comforting as his name. Despite being through a lot, he loves cuddles and will make that known with a nudge of the paw. He's also terrific with dogs, remaining calm even in the face of high energy ones. His easygoing nature makes him a wonderful companion for both quiet evenings and busy households alike.

He could use some TLC as he recovers from some injuries, but his patient, calm demeanor makes it easy to care for this gentle guy.

Brisket came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services. He joined POMDR due to his medical needs.

Sponsored By: Brody; Tetyana Margolina in memory of Marty, Sherwood and Leonid

name: Firefly
writeup:
Meet Firefly, the tiniest spark of summer magic you'll ever cuddle! Firefly is a pint-sized pal with a personality that shines brighter than a jar full of lightning bugs on a warm summer night. Don't let his small size fool you, this little guy brings big camp counselor energy wherever he goes. Whether he's leading a backyard adventure or supervising your snack time like a seasoned s'mores inspector, Firefly is always ready to turn ordinary moments into a sun-soaked memory.

By day, Firefly loves basking in patches of sunlight with dog and human pals alike. By evening, he's all about cozy vibes and snuggle sessions. Firefly would thrive in a home that appreciates his sparkle!

Firefly joined us from the Moreno Valley shelter after they found he needed more medical care than their overfull shelter was able to offer.

name: Orange Crush
writeup:
Orange Crush (AKA OC) is a sweet senior gentleman with a heart as warm as a summer sunset and a smile that's impossible to resist. This lovable old soul has mastered the art of companionship, asking for nothing more than a cozy bed, gentle pets, and someone to love throughout his golden years. While Orange Crush may have a little gray on his muzzle, his heart is overflowing with affection, gratitude, and quiet joy. If you're looking for a best friend who will fill your home with comfort, loyalty, and unconditional love, Orange Crush is ready to prove that life's sweetest chapters often come a little later.

OC is living proof that resilience comes in the sweetest little package. He is deaf, has very limited vision, and suffered from such severe dental disease that all of his teeth had to be removed. Yet none of that has dimmed his gentle spirit or his incredible capacity to love.

According to his foster, he is house-trained, never barks, sleeps soundly through the night, and eats like a champ. His favorite activities include soaking up the sunshine, snoozing in a cozy dog bed, and greeting each new day with quiet enthusiasm. As soon as he realizes you're awake, he'll be ready for his morning trip outside! Once he knows and trusts you, he'll happily seek out affection and reward you with the sweetest, slurpiest kisses.

OC's back legs are a little weak, so a single-level home would be ideal. But don't let that fool you, he still enjoys short walks and even has adorable bursts of playful energy. He gets excited to meet other dogs and enjoys their company, making him a wonderful companion for a home with canine friends.

Orange Crush has overcome more than any dog should ever have to endure, yet he greets each day with quiet contentment and a heart full of love. All he needs now is a family who will give him the comfort, kindness, and security he's always deserved. Could you be the happy ending this sweet senior has been waiting for?

This adorable gentleman joined the POMDR family from Hitchcock Road Animal Services in Salinas after being found as a stray in heartbreaking condition. It was clear he had endured a very difficult life before finding his way to POMDR. Now, he's finally ready for the life every dog deserves, a safe, loving home where he can spend his golden years surrounded by the love he's waited so long to find.

Sponsored By: Jillian Kozyra

name: Tamagotchi
writeup:
Say hello to Tamagotchi! He's just about he happiest little Chihuahua you'll ever meet! Just like the beloved '90s toy he's named after, this tiny guy is full of life, personality, and joy. When Tamagotchi sees people, his whole body lights up: tail wagging, wiggle mode activated, and smiles guaranteed all around.

Tamagotchi is incredibly sweet and affectionate, and clearly loves being around humans. He does well with other dogs, though right now he can be a bit over-the-top excited. We expect this enthusiasm to settle nicely once he's neutered through our program.

Tamagotchi joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best in a senior focused rescue.

name: Blockbuster
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This little man is ready to be the star of your home movie lineup! Blockbuster is a total crowd pleaser with other dogs and plays well with his canine co-stars. Blockbuster has all the makings of a cult classic: small, charming, and full of potential. Whether he ends up being an action hero, a rom-com snuggler, or a laid-back indie flick kind of guy, he's excited to find a forever home where he can shine.

Blockbuster loves to go for walks or find a sunny spot near a window to relax. His foster reports he is not particularly vocal and does seek out pets and affection from people. Blockbuster would definitely love to be someone's little shadow. Blockbuster does have some boundaries with handling and would love to land in a dog save home.

Blockbuster joined us from Silicon Valley Animal Care and Authority after he was found as a stray. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best supported by a senior focused rescue.

name: Tarzan and Jane
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Tarzan & Jane! Twice the Love, Double the Joy! Tarzan and Jane are a bonded pair with hearts as big as their personalities. If you're looking for loyal companions who will fill your home with love, laughter, and unconditional affection, these two are ready to meet you.

Jane is the ultimate cuddle bug. She loves curling up next to her people and would happily spend an evening snuggled on the couch-or better yet, on your lap. Although she has very limited vision (okay, she's basically blind) she doesn't let it define her. She enjoys going for walks and, once she learns her surroundings, gets around remarkably well. Like all of us, she's not perfect, but her resilience, gentle spirit, and loving heart shine through every day.

Tarzan is full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He has one hilarious superpower: if there's an open car door, don't be surprised if he launches himself into the seat like a little Superman, convinced it's time for a road trip! To Tarzan, every car ride is another chance to be with his favorite people, and his excitement is impossible not to love.

Together, they're the perfect team. They adore each other, but they also have a funny little rivalry over one very important prize-your lap! What makes Tarzan and Jane truly special isn't just their bond with each other-it's how completely they love their humans. Whether they're joining you for a neighborhood stroll, riding shotgun on an adventure, or simply relaxing at home, they're happiest when they're by your side.

These two don't need a perfect family-because none of us are perfect. They simply need someone willing to love them for who they are. In return, they'll give you unwavering loyalty, endless affection, daily laughter, and the kind of companionship that only dogs who know they've found home can offer.

If you have room in your heart for two incredible dogs, Tarzan and Jane are ready to fill your life with twice the love, twice the joy, and a lifetime of unforgettable moments.

Tarzan and Jane joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services. They were picked up as strays. Due to their senior status and Jane's vision impairments, they felt they would do best in the hands of a senior rescue.

Sponsored By: Vivi, Jessica and Oliver; Steph

name: Malcolm
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Malcolm (or Mac as his friends call him) is a stunning Husky boy with soulful eyes and a sensitive, thoughtful nature. He's 'not your average Husky'! This darling boy doesn't seem to know his size or breed description as he is a total lap dog and as quiet as they come! He thrives in calm, predictable environments and is described by those who know him as a 'love sponge'! He's ready to soak in all of the love you have to give him!

Malcolm is looking for a dog savvy home without other large breeds around. He does best with smaller dogs or would shine as the only dog in the home. He's a smart boy, loves treats, and is eager to please which makes this boy the perfect candidate for some future training with his next family. Malcolm would prefer a home without kitties as he does like to chase them.

Mac joined the POMDR pack from a local shelter after he was removed from concerning conditions in the home.

Sponsored By: Benji and Magnolia

name: Mighty Joe
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This lovable lad is the definition of a perfect companion when in the right home. Whether you're heading out for a hike, spending the day at the beach, or curling up with a good book, Joe is happily along for the ride (or the nap). He's wonderfully chill when he wants to be but loves the active life as well. He's the best of both worlds!

Joe is a social little guy with a big heart. He greets everyone he meets with an enthusiastic, lightning-fast tail wag. While Joe loves to make new friends, Joe has his quirks that his adoptive home will need to learn to work with.

He has nipped in a few of his foster homes, typically when putting on his harness or being touched when he isn't ready for it. We did X-rays to see if he was experiencing pain and found out he has arthritis in both shoulders but very severe in his right shoulder. We also discovered that he had a ballistic pellet (BB? shrapnel?) lodged in his left femur. This doesn't seem to be causing any pain, but it does let us know this pup has been through some rough times. He is now on anti-inflammatory medication and pain killers, and he is doing much better. Because he has nipped and drawn some blood, we need to be extra careful about his next placement.

He can be reactive to other dogs when out on leash, but is getting much better with training. He can get along with mellow dogs (usually preferring smaller ones), but he'd most likely thrive as the only pet in the house. Because of his need for ongoing behavior support, Mighty Joe's adoption will come with a $1,000 training stipend for work with a private trainer who can assist with behavior support as he transitions to his forever home.

Darling Joe joined us from the Bradshaw Animal Shelter when they reached out seeking placement with a senior focused rescue that could help with his medical needs. He came to us heart-worm positive. He has been through the heart-worm treatment and now has a clean bill of health.

Sponsored By: Oluseyi F. Ogundimu

name: Spork
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Spork! This sweet little Granny is simply irresistible! Now in her golden years, she has absolutely perfected the art of gazing at you with her big puppy dog eyes politely asking for treats -- irresistible! Furthermore, she sports the softest, most beautiful silver curls that are enticing everyone to pet her. This alluring charm has not been lost on her foster family, but they are more than happy to show her the good life she so much deserves. Granny's ideal day includes a leisurely stroll through the yard, a soft blanket in her bed for a long nap, and a human who will exclaim that she is 'the cutest thing ever' at least five times a day. Don't let her age fool you -- she has plenty of pep in her step when it's time for a snack run! This indoor enthusiast is a delightful companion who will make you laugh by putting on a show with her quirky displays.

If you have been searching for a perfectly-sized, silky-soft, and charming comedian, Granny is ready to serve up joy with a side of adorable attitude! Extra bonus: she gets along splendidly with other dogs, with cats, and gentle children. While overall in good shape, she will require daily medication for Cushing's disease and liver support, as well as ample reminders for potty breaks. Since joining POMDR, she has been receiving all the TLC she desperately needed and is feeling much better than when she first arrived.

This sweet lady joined us from San Jose Animal Care Center and Services, who thought she would shine best in a senior-focused rescue.

name: Watson
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Lovable little Watson is a tiny senior Chihuahua at his best. He may be getting along in years, but he still has some toddle left in those legs of his. He has a bit of osteoarthritis in his hips, but he doesn't let that slow him down at all. Aside from taking in the sights and smells around him, Watson loves a good sunbathing session. He'd love to lounge around the yard this summer with you!

Watson is lovely with cats and humans but prefers to be the only pup in the home. In his retirement years, he really just wants all of love for himself (and we understand!)!

Watson joined us from the Sacramento Bradshaw shelter where he landed after being found as a stray. They wanted to help him find a forever family ready to meet the needs of a senior dog, so he joined the POMDR family!

name: Abby
writeup:
Meet Abby, a beautiful senior sweetheart. This gentle girl deserves all the comforts that come with a home: a cozy bed, kind people, and a peaceful place to rest. After spending time in the shelter, Abby is ready to trade concrete floors for comfy blankets and beds. If you have room in your heart and home for a senior dog, Abby would love nothing more than to spend her golden years by your side.

She gets along great with other dogs and even seems to do well with kitty friends. Abby does need support from time to time as her back end gains strength. She is looking for a family that is able to physically support her at times when she needs help getting up or a boost into the car.

Abby was found living in a homeless encampment after her guardian sadly passed. She came to us from the Los Banos Animal Shelter.

Sponsored By: Mariel Halupa

name: Yeti
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This fluffy boy scrambled down the rugged mountains just to climb right into your heart! He absolutely charms everyone with his soulful eyes and no one can resist petting his amazing mane. Yeti is as gentle, loving, and sweet as can be and he is the perfect snuggle buddy for cozy evenings and quiet mornings.

Yeti moves through life at an easy pace. He is not much for long walks, but he definitely loves yard explorations, sunbathing, treats, belly rubs, and just being near his favorite people. He is great around other dogs as well as cats and even kids. This mellow gentleman is looking for a peaceful, loving home where he can enjoy his golden years surrounded by kindness, comfort, and plenty of snacks. He would prefer a house and a yard that he can easily navigate, without tricky steps or staircases.

Yeti joined us from Contra Costa Animal Services. Due to his senior status and their constraints for space, they felt he would do best in a senior-focused rescue to find his forever family.

Sponsored By: Jillian Kozyra

name: Bingo
writeup:
Meet Bingo! No party game required, just a sweet girl ready to steal your heart! She has the perfect blend of spunk and snuggles, making her a wonderful companion for both adventures and lazy afternoons.

Weighing in at 13 pounds, she's an ideal size for weekend strolls around town or curling up beside you in bed. Bingo is crate trained and does beautifully in the home.

Through no fault of her own, Bingo's loving family was no longer able to care for her, so she has joined the POMDR program.

name: Winkle
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Mister Winkle got his moniker from the sheer amount of hours he logged sleeping upon his arrival to our rescue. All that beauty sleep really paid off as he now happily toddles about the house, pretending he's Goldilocks, trying out every bed before settling in for a full nights sleep. Don't let this sweet little face fool you, he's nine pounds of pure perseverance and tougher than a two dollar steak, having successfully recovered from a few health setbacks over his illustrious decade of life. (Who needs teeth with a smile like that, anyways? He's very happy with his soft meals and treats.) His Cataracts don't slow down his exploring or ability to find his parents for snuggles either. Wink would also like you to know that he is a fiscally responsible fellow and has a retirement savings account of $1,500 to help offset any future vet care costs that may arise as he peacefully enjoys his sunset years by your side.

Winkle had severe dental disease when he came to POMDR and had to have all his teeth removed. He enjoys soft food at mealtime and soft treats throughout the day. Winkle has cataracts but he finds his way around the house and yard very well. Winkle had an anal sac tumor removed recently. We are hopeful that he has many more months or years ahead of him. Because of his medical situation, POMDR is offering his adopter a $1500 stipend for medical expenses.

Winkle came to POMDR from another rescue group when they discovered that his medical needs were more than they could handle. Senior dogs like Winkle with minor senior-related issues are our specialty so we were happy to bring him into our program.

name: Maxwell
writeup:
Some dogs wear their stories on their sleeves, and sweet Maxwell is one of them. This handsome senior poodle mix was rescued from a hoarding situation along with 14 other dogs, and the world was a very big, scary place when he first arrived. But every day since then, Maxwell has shown us just how resilient and brave he truly is.

While he's still building confidence, the progress he's made has been nothing short of amazing. The little victories that many dogs take for granted; trusting new people, exploring new environments, and learning that good things happen when humans are around have been huge milestones for Maxwell. Watching him grow has been a privilege, and we know his journey is only beginning.

Maxwell is looking for a patient, kind, and understanding family willing to let him move at his own pace. He doesn't need perfection; he just needs someone who will celebrate every small step forward and remind him that he is safe, loved, and home. The lucky person who adopts Maxwell won't just be gaining a dog, they'll get the incredible reward of watching a once shy soul truly blossom.

name: Gumdrop
writeup:
Meet Gumdrop, the sweetest little treat you'll ever meet! This adorable English Bulldog is all about love, snuggles, and soaking up every bit of attention she can get. She has the softest heart and will happily curl up next to you for naps, belly rubs, and lazy afternoons. But don't be fooled -- this sweet girl has a lot of energy and would love an active household!

Gumdrop does great with other dogs and loves having canine friends to hang out with. She would prefer a home without cats (she thinks they're just too mysterious!). If you're looking for a loyal, cuddly companion who will fill your days with joy, love, and bulldog charm, Gumdrop is your girl!

Gumdrop joined us from Contra Costa Animal Services.

Sponsored By: Barbara Weigel

name: Lance
writeup:
Lance is a charming senior fellow looking for a patient and loving home to call his own. While he may be a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, once he feels safe and comfortable, his sweet personality begins to shine.

Lance gets along well with other dogs and would likely enjoy having a canine companion to help show him the ropes. He's looking for a family that understands that confidence takes time and is willing to let him settle in at his own pace. With patience, kindness, and a little encouragement, Lance will blossom into a loyal and loving companion. If you're looking for a gentle soul to cheer on as he gains confidence, Lance might be the perfect match for you.

Lance joined POMDR after being rescued from a hoarding situation with 14 other dogs. He is gaining confidence every day and ready to land in his forever home.

name: Belle
writeup:
Belle is a sweet little lady who came to us from a difficult hoarding situation. Life hasn't always been easy for her, so she approaches the world with a quiet, cautious heart. But once she feels safe, her soft affection and gentle spirit shine through. Belle is happiest in calm surroundings. She's not the type of dog who wants busy adventures or crowded outings, she's much more of a homebody. New places and lots of stimulation can feel overwhelming, so she's looking for a mellow, patient home where she can settle in at her own pace.

One thing that helps Belle feel secure? Other dogs. She does well with calm canine companions and often takes comfort in their presence. A friendly resident dog could help her continue building confidence.

Belle joined POMDR after being rescued from a hoarding situation with 14 other dogs. She's still gaining confidence every day but she's ready to land in her forever home.

Sponsored By: The Momdjian Family

name: Old Man Jenkins
writeup:
This sweet senior boy has been through more than his fair share, coming from a difficult hoarding situation, but you'd never know it from his gentle, loving nature. Old Man Jenkins is a true sweetheart who is ready to leave the past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and kindness he's always deserved.

He's the kind of dog who just wants a soft place to land -- a cozy bed, a calm home, and a person to love. His days are best spent relaxing near his people, soaking up affection, and enjoying the simple pleasures of life at his own easy pace. Despite everything he's been through, Old Man Jenkins has so much love left to give. He's resilient, kind-hearted, and so deserving of a home where he can feel safe, cherished, and at peace.

Old Man Jenkins joined POMDR after being rescued from a hoarding situation with 14 other dogs.

name: Margaret
writeup:
If you're looking for a gentle shadow with the cutest little zoomies you've ever seen, Margaret is your girl! This sweet senior knows how to enjoy the simple things in life: leisurely walks, long naps, cozy couch snuggles, belly rubs, and staying close to her favorite people.

Margaret is easygoing and gets along beautifully with other dogs, and she peacefully coexists with cats, too. She may be a little cautious when meeting new people, but give her a few moments, or treats and she'll happily soak up all the love and attention. She's perfectly content exploring the yard, snoozing the day away, or following her foster mom from room to room. She even loves being held like a baby!

Margaret walks wonderfully on leash and enjoys getting out for strolls at her own relaxed pace. She's a low-energy companion who's happy to match your lifestyle. When left alone, she's content to curl up for a nap, and while she might let you know if the doorbell rings or if a suspicious traffic cone appears outside, she's otherwise a calm, quiet housemate.

She's still polishing up her housetraining and would do best in a home without lots of stairs, as her back legs aren't as strong as they once were. But don't let that fool you, this little lady still has plenty of joy, love, and zoomies to share.

Everyone who meets Margaret falls head over heels for her, and it's easy to see why. She's unbelievably sweet, incredibly soft, absolutely adorable, and has a heart as big as her love for belly rubs. If you're looking for a loyal best friend to fill your home with gentle companionship and daily smiles, Margaret is ready to steal your heart.

Margaret joined POMDR from Contra Costa Animal Services when it was determined that, given her age, she would be a good fit for our program.

Sponsored By: Tammy Rieser and the dawg kids

name: Mihla
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Don't let her frosted gray coat fool you, this 8 year old is pure sunshine around those she loves. A copilot extraordinaire, this trusty girl loves being a passenger princess (just don't ask her to back up the trailer.) She's a wonderful walk companion and trail guide, who takes great joy in pointing out the local flora and fauna to her companions. She took up knitting while waiting for her forever home to find her, after 731+ days at it, her scarf now qualifies for a Guinness book world record but she's holding out hope!

Miss Mihla enjoys spending her time going for car rides or long walks, playing surgeon with squeaky toys, alerting her fosters about squirrels and birds that dare to cross her path, and attending training regularly to work on building up her leash manners.

This lovely lady would be ideal for a home where she can be the star and not have to share your attention but she may also fit right in with a household that has a mellow dog who doesn't mind sharing the spotlight. Due to how excited we have seen her get around prey animals we suspect she may not be ideal for a household with cats. We have not seen how she is with children.

The SPCA of Monterey County reached out to us for help because Mihla was becoming increasingly stressed in the shelter environment. She was a favorite among many volunteers who worked with her there, so how could we resist?

Sponsored By: Judy LeRoy, Tetyana Margolina

name: Osmosis Jones
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This confident, happy-go-lucky bundle of joy has a zest for life that is absolutely contagious, proving that age is just a number. Osmosis Jones greets every new day, every person, and most dogs with an ever-wagging tail and a cheerful smile. While content around dogs of any size, he is most interested in interactions with humans. His foster family reports that he is polite around parrots and is likely friendly with cats as well. Out and about, this gentleman is more of a sniffer than a walker, consequently his cruising speed is more stop than go. On top of his list of favorite activities is going on car rides and being next to his favorite person.

Never naughty, always nice, all Osmosis Jones asks for this holiday season is a family who will love and cherish him unconditionally. In return, this sweet old soul will be forever grateful, ready to spread warmth, joy, and endless devotion to the lucky folks who will welcome him home.

Osmosis Jones came to POMDR from Silicon Valley Animal Control Authority after he was picked up as a stray.

Sponsored By: Barbara Weigel

name: Yankee Candle
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Yankee Candle, a distinguished senior Pomeranian with enough fluff to make a pillow jealous. Yankee Candle has mastered the art of the leisurely stroll, the power nap, and supervising snack time like a true connoisseur. He may not bark much, but when he does, it's with style and definitely for decorative purposes. Think of him as a living, breathing, four-legged scented candle: comforting, charming, and impossible to ignore.

Yankee Candle is looking for a forever home where he can retire in comfort and style. He dreams of a life filled with cozy laps, soft blankets, and humans who appreciate the fine art of senior dog snuggles. If you're ready for a lifetime of warmth, laughter, and fluff, Yankee Candle is the perfect addition to light up your life, no flame required.

This handsome boy joined us after the San Jose Animal Care Center reached out about placing him in a more senior focused rescue.

name: Gabby
writeup:
Gorgeous Gabby may be enjoying her golden years, but this sweet senior Schnoodle still has plenty of pep in her step! She loves her daily walks, basking in the sunshine, and staying close to her people for gentle pets and affection. With her moderate energy level, Gabby is the perfect companion for someone who enjoys a leisurely stroll followed by a cozy cuddle session on the couch.

Gabby is as easygoing as they come. She gets along wonderfully with both dogs and cats, making her a great fit for many types of homes. She isn't demanding or overbearing - just a calm, loving presence with soulful eyes that have a way of capturing everyone's heart. Gabby is also delightfully quiet, usually only offering a bark or two every few days when she's hoping for a little extra attention.

One of Gabby's many wonderful qualities is that she is fully housetrained, according to her foster. In fact, she arrived without even a single accident, which is a rare and impressive testament to what a good girl she is.

Since arriving, Gabby has been receiving the medical care she needs to help her feel her best. She is currently being treated for Cushing's disease and is working toward losing approximately 9 pounds. Her weight loss journey will take time, even with reduced calories, and may require several months of patience and consistency. Reaching a healthier weight is an important step before she can safely undergo a dental cleaning and have a couple of lipomas removed.

Gabby is also an enthusiastic eater and has a habit of consuming things she shouldn't. Her future family will need to provide a safe environment by keeping potentially harmful items out of reach, including products such as snail or rat bait.

Gabby is a special senior girl who deserves a home where her health needs are understood and where she can spend her days feeling safe, loved, and cherished. If you believe life's sweetest companions only get better with age, Gabby is ready to show you just how wonderful a senior dog can be.

Gabby joined the POMDR pack after her loving guardian was no longer able to care for her.

name: Peppercorn
writeup:
Peppercorn: Tiny, Toasty, and Professionally Cozy!
If your dream dog is less "let's hike a mountain" and more "let's perfect the art of napping," then Peppercorn may just be your soulmate. This sweet senior lady has officially retired from the hustle and bustle and is now accepting applications for the coveted position of Full-Time Couch Companion. Her hobbies include snoozing, relaxing, snoozing some more, and quietly keeping you company while you read, watch TV, or enjoy a peaceful afternoon.

Peppercorn is a gentle, shy little soul who takes a couple of days to settle into new surroundings, but once she feels safe, she's the easiest roommate you could ask for. She isn't demanding or noisy, she simply enjoys being near her people. While she's not a big cuddler or kisser, she's happiest curled up beside you on the couch or snuggled next to you in bed at night. Because her vision is limited, she appreciates a helping hand getting onto furniture, and she'll happily drift off to sleep once she's tucked in beside you.

Life with Peppercorn is delightfully low-key. She strolls nicely on leash at her own leisurely pace, rides beautifully in the car (usually sleeping the whole trip), and politely ignores other dogs while out and about. She gets along well with calm canine companions as long as they respect her personal space and don't crowd her face. She's not interested in toys, but if you happen to have a tiny piece of real meat to share, you've just become her favorite chef. Since she has no teeth, soft treats and bite-sized snacks are the way to her heart.

Peppercorn is looking for a quiet, patient home where she can enjoy her golden years at her own pace. Because of her limited vision, she relies on her people to help her outside for potty breaks, when she starts pacing, she's letting you know it's time to go. With a little routine and a lot of love, she's an incredibly easy companion who asks for very little in return. If you're searching for a gentle, peaceful little shadow to share your home with, Peppercorn is ready to spend her retirement exactly where she belongs: right by your side.

Little Peppercorn joined us from Bradshaw Sacramento County Animal Services after she was brought in as a stray. Due to her senior status, they felt she would do best in a senior focused rescue to find her forever people.

name: Snowflake
writeup:
Meet Snowflake, a dainty senior Chihuahua with a whisper-soft presence and a way of quietly stealing hearts. True to her name, she's delicate, gentle, and most content in peaceful moments, nestled in blankets, snoozing in a sunny spot, or resting close to her favorite person.

Snowflake has a heart condition that's being lovingly managed with medication, and she's hoping for a calm, understanding home where she can enjoy her golden years at her own sweet pace. She's not looking for adventure -- just warmth, patience, and someone who will treasure the quiet magic of a senior soul. Snowflake may be small, but the love she gives is something truly special.

Snowflake joined POMDR from Hitchcock Road Animal Services in Salinas.

name: Poppy
writeup:
Poppy is the most happy-go-lucky bundle of energy who sports endless tail wags, zoomies, and flop-overs all day long! She adores attention, snuggles, and ear scratches and is very friendly with everyone she meets. Although we have not observed her interacting with young children, we are fairly confident that she would be a perfect companion for kids. She gets along great with other dogs as well as with cats.

This sweet pup enjoys extensive yard explorations and walks well on leash. If you are looking for a speed-walking partner, Poppy is your girl! For indoor exercise, she likes chasing and retrieving toys. She is content on car rides and also does not mind staying home alone now and then. Being the social butterfly that she is, she certainly prefers to have human company most of the time and would do best in a home with other pups or even kitties.

Until she joined POMDR, she had been an outdoor-only dog for a bit. She has since soaked up all the comforts of indoor living, but she definitely enjoys the freedom to roam around in a spacious yard. This free spirit may also try to take liberties to take herself on a joy-stroll around the block. Thus she will need a securely fenced yard to keep her safe.

Poppy came to us after her guardian became ill and was no longer able to care for her.

Sponsored By: Prisila and Richard Johnson, Jen and Chuck Hernandez

name: Nougat
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This morsel of canine goodness is a gourmet kind of Nougat, with extra sugar and honey mixed in. Snuggling on the couch seriously turns him into a sweet and slightly nutty blob. In other words, he is the most affectionate little guy and loves to be as close to his person as possible all day long. On top of that, he has these soulful eyes that look straight into your soul and pull on your heartstrings. Nougat very much enjoys meeting new people, will solicit pets, and invite himself into anyone's lap. Mr. Nougat likes going for daily walks and is well-behaved on leash. He is friendly when meeting other dogs and he fits in just about anywhere, from cozy tiny house to spacious mansion. Overall, he is very adaptable and would likely be a happy camper joining a family with any level of activity.

We don't know much about Nougat's past, as he was found as a stray and brought into Santa Clara County Animal Services. They decided a more senior specific rescue would help him find the best home to meet his needs.

Sponsored By: Joan Best

name: Hatchi
writeup:
Handsome Hatchi the Husky is looking for his forever home. Could it be yours? This well-mannered fellow enjoys walks, romps with other pups, and spending time with his people. He is a good boy with adults and children, minding his manners for every meeting. He is a gentleman with other dogs and does not mind the presence of kitties, giving a polite sniff and then moving along. He especially loves giving kisses to people! Hatchi also does not seem to be anxious about being home without his people, but he sure is happy when they return, joyfully greeting them and showing his affection with his Husky song! He also enjoys riding in the car and makes sure to stick his head out the window to get the full experience!

Hatchi is a typical Husky in that he will need a securely fenced yard and will benefit from daily walks or trips to the dog park to get that playful energy out and allow him to safely explore. His ideal day might look something like a car ride to a fun hiking or walking adventure, followed by curling up on a soft blanket and settling in for the evening with his family.

This sweet boy came to us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being surrendered by his guardian. He was adopted and loved for a few years, but his adopter ultimately found that his intensive work schedule was not fair to Hatchi. Hatchi now continues his journey to find his loving forever home.

Sponsored By: Steph

name: Clove
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Say hello to Clove, a snuggly sweetheart who is as warm and comforting as his name suggests. With his soft coat and tender heart, Clove is a lovely little companion to curl up with on a crisp autumn evening.

Clove is gentle and affectionate, but he is also a sensitive soul who needs a calm, patient family willing to let him set the pace especially when it comes to handling. With his favorite people, this boy shines like no other! He loves to rub his body on you with the best smile to showcase his excitement to spend time with his people! Clove loves snuggling in blankets almost as much as he adores car rides- looking out the window and feeling a little wind in his hair are some of his favorite activities.

Clove enjoys neighborhood strolls, car adventures, and simply being near his person but this boy has zero FOMO. Separation anxiety is not even in his vocabulary. He's perfectly content making himself a new blanket fort while you are away. Clove does great with other dogs of all shapes, sizes, and attitudes and even gets along great with kitty friends.

Curious Clove came to POMDR from San Jose Animal Care and Services after he was found as a stray. We can't wait to see this amazing boy blossom into his new home!

name: Rita
writeup:
Rita is a well mannered golden gal with a heart full of love and a calm, easygoing charm. She's the kind of companion who's happiest in the simple moments: cozy snuggles, gentle strolls, and quietly keeping you company just because she loves being near you.

Rita is a golden girl with golden manners. She'll greet you with a warm, happy hello and is always ready to settle in close at your feet, beside you on the couch, or wherever her favorite person happens to be. She doesn't ask for much, just your presence, patience, and a soft spot to land. She's cat friendly and has done well living with feline and canine housemates.

Rita has a gentle, sensitive side when it comes to handling, so she appreciates slow, kind movements and a steady routine. She prefers not to be picked up or moved abruptly, and with consistency and care, she settles in beautifully. Her twice-daily medication is part of her routine and she does well when it's thoughtfully tucked into meals.

Rita came to POMDR after her guardian moved into assisted living and could no longer care for her. Now she's ready for her next chapter,a quiet, loving home where she can share her steady devotion, soft companionship, and endless sweetness.

name: Mattie aka Matteo
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Mattie is a sweet little lamb, following his foster people around the house hoping for snacks! He was in ruff shape when he came to POMDR, but with the loving care of his foster family and attention to his medical needs, he has become a new dog! We have determined that Mattie is hard of hearing, but you wouldn't notice it for how attentive he is to his surroundings.

He is on inexpensive medications for Cushing's disease and low thyroid. Luckily, he is a champ at taking his meds!

He does very well around other dogs and is super food motivated! Besides meal time and snack time, Mattie also loves his naps. He loves to wander around the yard and explore the house. He doesn't really need leash walks. He gets his steps in around the house! He does just fine being left at home, and would likely get along fine with cat friends.

Mattie joined us from Los Banos Animal Services after being found as a stray. They realized it was in Mattie's best interest to land with a senior dog rescue. We're happy to report that Mattie is on the path to a whole new life! Can you be his forever home?

name: Pine
writeup:
Meet our tiny queen Pine, the one, the only, Miss "I Do What I Want!" An independent woman seeking her loving forever home. While other dogs are busy handing out kisses and demanding constant cuddles, this senior gal has important business to attend to. Napping in sunbeams? Yes. Enjoying your household from her favorite cozy bed? Absolutely. Being glued to your side 24/7? Hard pass. She's an independent lady who appreciates companionship on her terms and isn't afraid of personal space or alone time. Talk about a confident queen!

This little legend is enjoying her golden years and does require a special kidney-friendly diet to help keep her feeling her best. In return, she'll provide endless entertainment with her quirky personality, tiny stature, and delightfully opinionated outlook on life. Think of her less as a dog and more as a tiny retired CEO who occasionally allows you into her presence.

If you're looking for a low-maintenance roommate, a professional sunbeam tester, and a dog who marches to the beat of her own adorable drum, this sweet senior may be your perfect match. Apply today and let this pint-sized queen show you how fabulous retirement can be!

Pine came from San Jose Animal Care and Services as a stray. Due to their overcrowded shelter and her senior status, they felt she would do best with a senior dog rescue.

name: Chad
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Cheerful Chad is a boy with a love for his toys and his people! This adorable little boy is ready for whatever adventure you have in store -- as long as he can bring along a stuffy! He's a hilarious little man with an irresistible personality. Chad's white fur is as soft as can be, and he likes a good back scratch while he shows you his favorite toy, with tail wags of course.

In his senior years, Chad has lost his vision and does seem to be blind. He has had a bit of a rough past and sadly a vet found a bullet lodged in him that is still there. He doesn't let that slow him down one bit though. Despite his rough past, Chad is crate trained, does excellent in the car, and is a fetch champion! He will bring each toy right back to you with gusto, and it is so joyful to watch him play! He loves to go for walks as well, and is a star on leash. Adopt Chad today and fill your home with smiles!

This sweet little guy joined us from San Jose Animal Services.

Sponsored By: Chris Pahl

name: Leaf
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - This sweet autumn spirit is a bright ray of sunshine on even the gloomiest days of fall. Leaf is a happy-go-lucky girl who loves cuddling up on the couch with you and she will keep you warmer than any cozy blanket on a crisp November afternoon. When she has recharged after a good nap, she enjoys long, fast-paced walks, extensive yard explorations, and chasing squirrels. She gets along nicely with most small, easygoing dogs but really isn't too fond of bigger pups who tower over her. Leaf would be happiest in a home without cats. Providing personal space is not always her strong suit as she likes to know what's going on with everyone in the household.

Leaf is very loving, super loyal. and ready to be right by your side while you sip a cup of cider and watch the foliage change colors outside your window. She is the best and most cheerful little companion that anyone could ever ask for and she is more than ready to meet her forever family. Be-Leaf is her motto!

Lovely Leaf joined POMDR from San Jose Animal Care and Services after she was picked up as a stray.

name: Casper
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Casper, the friendly pup! This senior lad is full of energy and loves to play with toys. He is a joyful guy with a big heart who is happy to tag along wherever you go. Sadly, Casper was recently diagnosed with lymphoma. Without treatment, his prognosis is only a few months to live. We are choosing to give him the best chance possible, so he is undergoing cancer treatment at a specialist in the Monterey area. Based on his energy and enthusiasm, you would never know he is fighting a serious illness! If his adopters are willing to continue bringing him to treatment appointments in Monterey post-adoption, POMDR will cover the cost of his treatment (approx. 288 days).

While Casper is very friendly and social, he is working on resource guarding from both people and other dogs. While he does well with his foster pup sibling, we think he would also love to be an only dog where he doesn't have to share his toys. Casper does great around cats. He is looking for a forever home where he can float right into your heart (and toy bin).

Handsome Casper joined us from the Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire. He was brought in as a stray. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best in a senior focused rescue.

name: Mimi
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Mimi! The sweetest little sidekick with the most adorable tongue that's always peeking out! Her silly smile makes everyone laugh. Mimi is incredibly affectionate and loves being close to her people, whether she's joining you for a walk, playing, or simply relaxing nearby.
