Mimi is the perfect mix of adventure buddy and couch companion. She loves walks, enjoys meeting new people and other dogs, rides wonderfully in the car, and is fully house-trained. She's also a world-class treat lover, so winning her heart is easy! While she can be a little shy in brand-new places, she gains confidence quickly with her favorite person by her side and settles in beautifully.

Her ideal day includes plenty of snacks, cozy naps, a little fun, and most importantly, spending time with the people she loves. Mimi would fit into almost any home, especially one that enjoys getting outside for walks and has lots of love to give. If you're looking for a loyal, playful best friend who will keep you smiling with her goofy little grin, Mimi is ready to meet you!.

Mimi joined us from the Sacramento County Bradshaw Animal Shelter. They reached out to POMDR after deciding she would do best in a senior focused rescue.

name: Pauly D
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Yeahhhh Buddy! Pauly D is looking for someone to live in the moment with him. Born with an enlarged heart that occasionally plays remix's of its own, his wish is for a home that understands his medical prognosis while celebrating each and every day he has with him.

This brave boy has been diagnosed with a heart murmur and enlarged heart, along with a variety of other ailments. If giving a pup with medical needs a second chance is your calling, then look no further, Pauly D is your boy.

Pauly D joined POMDR from Ventura County Animal Services to help alleviate the overcrowding at the shelter.

name: Gracie
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - She's got style, she's got grace, she's a winner! Sweet and happy Gracie is a perfectly polite companion who is friendly with everyone she meets. At her foster home, she gets along with the other small resident dogs as well as cats, and she ignores the chickens. This darling will follow you around the home, not needing attention, but just observing your daily chores and routines. As reimbursement for her diligent supervision, Gracie appreciates regular meals, a couple of well-timed treats, walks around the neighborhood, and lots of love. Although she definitely prefers when her human companion is around, she is also fine when left home alone for a little while. She is house trained and sleeps quietly in her enclosure overnight, but if it were up to her, she would probably prefer to sleep in bed with her humans. Gracie is smart and attentive, and has been learning some basic commands. She will pick up a ball on occasion, likes chewing on antlers, and does well in the car.

This pretty lady is hearing and vision impaired, but gets around well and pays attention to her fellow dogs for all the important treat signals. Up until now, Gracie did not get a chance to live life to the fullest, and she is eager to catch up on the plush pampered poodle lifestyle. We are so excited to see this diamond in the rough starting to sparkle!!

Gracie joined us from Santa Clara County Animal Care and Services where she was brought in as a stray.

Sponsored By: Charlotte Tanner; Tammy Rieser, GSD Peyton, Corgi Finnegan and the Noodle Doxie crew

name: Zelda
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Zelda is a tiny but mighty, loving little lady looking for her forever home. She loves being carried in her foster mom's pouch, and is always content to toddle around the yard in the sun. Zelda loves to be the center of attention, and we think she would do best in home without other dogs.

Zelda recently had one of her eyes removed, and is healing like a total champ. She would love nothing more than to live out her golden years in a warm and loving home.

Zelda came to POMDR from Santa Clara County Animal Services.

Sponsored By: Joan Best

name: Bumper Car
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Bumper Car is just the perfect blend of sweet and spunky! Bumper Car may be blind, but she sees the world with her heart- and what a big, beautiful heart it is. Whether she's following the sound of your voice or curling up beside you for snuggles, Bumper Car is all about connection. Despite her vision loss, she's a confident little navigator who quickly learns her surroundings. Her sense of smell and hearing are top-notch, and she uses them like a pro to explore, adapt, and find her favorite cozy spots.

She gets along beautifully with other dogs and cats, and her gentle energy makes her a joy to be around. If you're looking for a lovable sidekick who will warm your heart, make you laugh, and remind you daily that joy has no limits -Bumper Car is your girl.

Bumper Car came to us from the Sacramento Animal Shelter after being found as a stray, but you'd never guess her past by her joyful spirit. She's already left the shelter life in her past and is ready to settle into a forever home where she'll be cherished for the sweet little treasure she is.

Sponsored By: JudyLeRoy

name: Neptune
writeup:
Neptune is a sweet, resilient little guy who is learning that the world is a wonderful place and he's ready to find his forever family! This handsome boy is a gentle soul with the biggest heart (and the cutest lopsided ears!). He walks beautifully on leash, never pulls, and is a wonderful walking companion. When he meets new dogs, Neptune shows excellent manners, politely sniffing and standing still while saying hello. He's curious about new friends and would likely enjoy a calm dog companion who respects his quiet moments.

Neptune is a mellow-to-moderate energy pup who enjoys leisurely walks, cozy naps, massages, and being loved on. He may not have discovered his favorite toys yet, but he has discovered the joy of a peanut butter lick mat and soaking up attention from his people.

This little gentleman loves being part of the family. He follows his humans from room to room, enjoys car rides, gives the sweetest kisses, and will happily settle in for couch time. He's a polite pup who waits for an invitation through doorways and checks in with his people to make sure he's doing everything right.

Neptune is also a brave little explorer. He approaches new people slowly and kindly, accepts treats, and is becoming more confident every day. He's been learning to live with cats and is showing patience and curiosity as he adjusts to his feline housemates. His ideal home would be one filled with love, patience, and plenty of affection. A calm environment where he can continue building confidence would be perfect. Neptune would love a family who will keep showing him the joys of play, adventures, and being someone's cherished companion.

Neptune joined POMDR from the Animal Resource Center of the Inland Empire in Southern California.

name: Buddy the Lab
writeup:
Buddy is a senior with a heart as big as they come. This sweet boy has spent his life being a loyal companion, and now he's looking for a gentle, loving home to spend his golden years.

Buddy is the definition of low maintenance. He's perfectly content with short strolls, cozy naps, and simply being near his person. His happiest moments are the quiet ones, resting by your side, soaking up affection, and offering that calm, comforting presence only a senior dog can provide. What Buddy needs most now is a soft place to land, a peaceful home and a kind human who will cherish him and keep him company. In return, he'll offer unwavering companionship, gentle affection, and a lifetime of love wrapped into his golden years.

Buddy came into rescue through no fault of his own. His devoted guardian recently moved into a nursing home and, heartbreakingly, can no longer care for him. Buddy is a little confused by all the change, but through it all, he remains incredibly sweet, trusting, and full of love to give.

Sponsored By: Emily Christensen, Carol Robinson, Kenneth Marks, Glenys Rodeback

name: Lenny
writeup:
Meet Lenny, a small gentleman with a heart as big as his personality. This tiny survivor has been through more than most dogs ever should, but thanks to the incredible care of POMDR's veterinary team, he's thriving and making the most of every single day. His absolute favorite thing in the world? Walks! Don't let his adorable wobble fool you, Lenny is a man on a mission, happily trotting along with places to be.

Lenny does have heart disease and will need daily medication for life, but he couldn't make it any easier. He happily takes every pill right from your hand like it's a special treat, and he's doing wonderfully on his current medication. Before he's neutered, POMDR will continue monitoring his heart to ensure anesthesia is safe, but in the meantime, he simply needs someone committed to his daily meds and ready to love him for the funny, resilient little guy he is.

Because of some neurological wobbliness, Lenny occasionally loses his balance or takes a tumble, but he never lets it slow him down. He's learned clever ways to help himself-like leaning against bushes when he goes potty and if he happens to get stuck in a pile of blankets or couch cushions, he'll appreciate a helping hand. For that reason, he'd do best in a home where someone is around often to keep an eye on him.

Lenny is the definition of a polite houseguest. He won't bark or whine when he needs to go outside; instead, he'll quietly walk to the door and patiently wait. If you're gone a little longer than expected, he'll even do his best to use a pee pad. He's wonderful with small dogs, respectful of cats, and would also be perfectly content as your one and only best friend. He's an incredibly gentle, sensitive soul who wants nothing more than to make his people happy, so kind encouragement is all he ever needs.

Like many former strays, Lenny still has a curious streak. He loves exploring little side trails on walks, so he'll always need a secure harness and leash, and because he's so small, a securely fenced yard without tiny escape routes is important. Once underweight when he arrived in rescue, he's now filled out beautifully and especially enjoys canned food with plenty of gravy to help keep him hydrated.

The very best part of Lenny isn't his speed, his funny little wobble, or even his sweet smile-it's the way he loves. When you come home, he'll climb onto the couch, flop his entire tiny body across you, shower you with kisses, and nuzzle his little face into yours with the happiest grin. At bedtime, he'll burrow under the blankets, wiggle down by your legs, and sleep there until morning. All Lenny wants is a cozy place to call home, someone to love with his whole medically complicated heart, and lots of fast walks shared together.

A generous secret admirer has already paid Lenny's adoption fee. Now all he's waiting for is the person who will see just how extraordinary this little survivor truly is and give him the forever home he's been dreaming of. Lenny joins us from Hitchcock Road Animals Services in Salinas after being found stray.

name: Stormie
writeup:
If you meet Stormie, you'll fall in love. This joyful, happy-hearted girl is always ready for her next adventure and brings a smile wherever she goes. Stormie loves playing fetch, chasing Frisbees, herding soccer balls, and splashing through water with pure excitement. Watching her run, play, and enjoy life is truly contagious! She is full of genuine happiness and enthusiasm.

Stormie is friendly with everyone she meets, including new people and other dogs, and she has done well around horses, too, but would prefer a house without cats. She loves car rides and rides quietly and calmly, making her the perfect companion for road trips and daily outings. At home, she is fully crate trained, well-behaved when left alone, and always eager to earn a treat; she'll do just about anything for a cookie!

While Stormie loves activity and playtime, she also has a sweet and affectionate side. She enjoys sitting close to her people, giving hugs, and sneaking a few kisses, especially on your ears if she gets the chance! Her ideal home would be with someone who enjoys walks, outdoor activities, and including their dog in everyday adventures. With a couple of good play sessions each day and plenty of love, Stormie is happiest when she's spending time with her people and canine friends.

Stormie is the kind of dog who makes every day brighter. Her joyful spirit, loving personality, and zest for life make her truly unforgettable. If you're looking for a loyal companion who is always ready for fun and affection, Stormie may be the perfect match for you.

Sweet Stormie was rescued by her amazing foster family after they found her in a very concerning state. She was severely underweight and in need of care, stability, and love. Thanks to the dedication of her foster family, Stormie has blossomed into the happy, healthy, and joyful dog she is today. She has come such a long way and is now ready to find the next lucky family to call her very own!

Sponsored By: Marlene Gordon

name: Doc Ricketts
writeup:
Meet Doc Ricketts. Named after Ed Ricketts, our brilliant and compassionate local marine biologist who inspired characters in the stories of John Steinbeck. Like his namesake, there's something deeply soulful about our boy Ricketts.

Doc Ricketts was found as a stray alongside his brother, both in heartbreaking condition. His small body was weak, his coat painfully tangled, and his eyes clouded with discharge and fatigue. He looked like a dog who had known far too little kindness in his life.

Despite what he has been through, Doc Ricketts absolutely loves people, dogs, and even cats. He greets everyone with quiet sweetness and has shown himself to be wonderfully social and accepting. Though he appears to be nearly blind and occasionally bumps into things or struggles with stairs until he adjusts, he truly enjoys going on walks and exploring the outdoors.

Doc Ricketts' ideal home would be with someone patient and compassionate who understands the needs of a visually impaired senior dog. He needs a family willing to help him navigate the world, keep him engaged, and most importantly, remind him every single day that he is loved. After a difficult life, this sweet boy deserves nothing less than comfort, kindness, and a cozy place to call his forever home.

Dear Doc Ricketts joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after being brought to the shelter as a stray. Due to his neglected state, they felt he would do best in the arms of a foster home and rescue to support his needs.

Sponsored By: Kennon Hudson

name: Furby
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Furby is a little bundle of cute with a big personality packed inside a small, wire haired package. He's a professional nap enthusiast and can often be found snoozing the day away in a comfy dog bed (bonus points if it's extra plush). That said, don't let his sleepy reputation fool you! Furby also loves getting out for walks and is great on leash, happily trotting along and soaking up the sights.

Furby is wonderful with other dogs, especially mellow companions who enjoy a calm, cozy vibe. If you're looking for a sweet, low-key buddy who's equally happy lounging by your side or heading out for a stroll, Furby might be the perfect fit. Adopt Furby and add a little extra "aww" to your everyday life!

Furby joined the POMDR pack after he was surrendered to a local shelter.

name: Gingerbread
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Fresh out of the oven and ready to warm your heart, Gingerbread is a charming little Chihuahua looking for a home to call his own this season! He's sweet as sugar, cute as a cookie, and good with other dogs! What's not to love? With his tiny size and big spirit, Gingerbread is the perfect festive companion to sprinkle a little extra joy into your days.

Whether he's trotting around like a cheerful holiday elf or curling up like the coziest Christmas treat, this little guy is sure to make your home feel brighter, warmer, and a whole lot sweeter.

Gingerbread joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best in a senior focused rescue.

name: Biggie
writeup:
Don't let his blindness fool you! Biggie sees the world through his heart, and what he sees is LOVE. Biggie is a sweet Pug with a gentle soul and a big personality. Despite being blind, he navigates life with the help of his other senses and, of course, his favorite humans! This little guy is incredibly affectionate, fantastic with children, and great with other dogs. He's calm, cuddly, and happiest when he's near his people.

Biggie would thrive in a home where someone is around most of the day. He's a true companion dog who wants nothing more than to be by your side (or in your lap!). Whether it's naptime, playtime, or just being your shadow around the house, Biggie is all in. He's got so much love to give and is looking for a family who will cherish his unique needs and bottomless heart. If you're ready to welcome a sweet, special boy into your life, Biggie is ready to love you forever.

This adorable, resilient guy joined us after his senior guardian could no longer care for him. He had some skin issues that needed care, but he's on track to have the most beautiful Pug fur soon!

Sponsored By: Aaron Patrick Reyes, Jen Snow

name: Katsu
writeup:
Meet Katsu (aka Katie), the sweetest little couch companion you could ask for! This gentle, low-energy girl is much more interested in a leisurely Sunday stroll than a power walk. She loves sniffing around the yard, following her people from room to room, and then adorably plopping onto the floor like a fluffy little mop just to keep you company. Katie has a heart of gold and simply wants to be a good girl, get along with everyone, and soak up all the love she can.

Katie is wonderfully easygoing with other dogs of all sizes, ages, and personalities; even the energetic ones and those who accidentally bump into her! She's happy to share a dog bed with her canine friends and would likely do well in a home with other pets, possibly even a cat. She greets new people with polite curiosity, happily accepts pets and cuddles, and is never demanding of attention. When she's feeling especially affectionate, she may even ask to curl up in your lap for a cozy snuggle.

A quiet and calm companion, Katie rarely barks, rides beautifully in the car, settles easily into her crate, and is perfectly content when left home alone. Toys aren't really her thing, she'd much rather spend her day lounging on a comfy bed, relaxing with her people, and enjoying a few gentle adventures. Katie is wonderful with children, but like many senior dogs, she is hard of hearing.

If you're looking for a sweet, mellow best friend with a beautiful heart, Katie may be your perfect match. Her dream home is one filled with kindness, cozy cuddle sessions, and people who will cherish her as much as she'll cherish them.

Katsu joined POMDR from Front Street Animal Shelter in Sacramento and is ready to find the loving forever home she deserves.

name: Doodle the Poodle aka Scooby
writeup:
Doodle is a sweet senior gentleman with a soft, fluffy coat and an even softer heart. After enduring a difficult past, he's now ready to leave those hard days behind and settle into the peaceful, loving home he's always deserved. This charming boy is all about the simple joys in life -- cozy beds, gentle walks, and quiet moments spent by your side. Doodle has a calm, easygoing nature and a soulful presence that makes him the perfect companion for someone looking for a loyal, low-key friend.

Doodle has had some tough days in his past but he is focused on the future and getting to know his next family. All he needs now is a safe place to land and a person to call his own. Doodle prefers the companionship of his people to be around much of his day as he's just so happy to have his friends around. He gets along beautifully with dogs big and small and would love to land in a home with other canine companions.

Doodle the Poodle joined POMDR after being rescued from a severe hoarding situation with 14 other dogs. Due to the high volume of dogs and his senior status, we were happy to have him join the POMDR pack while he finds his forever home.

Sponsored By: Kennon Hudson

name: Hawk
writeup:
Meet Hawk, a distinguished senior gentleman with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. This charming fellow has perfected the art of relaxation, enjoys leisurely strolls, and gives the best gentle snuggles. He will gladly sit in your lap too!

In his foster home, Hawk loves to enjoy a lick mat and toddle around the house following his foster mom. He is truly a mellow and consistent guy! Hawk may be older, but he is wise, affectionate, and ready to bring a lifetime of calm companionship (and a little bit of mischief) to the right home. Hawk does great around other pups but would also be happy to be a solo dog, either works for him as long as pets and attention are involved!

Hawk joined POMDR after his guardian moved to assisted living and needed help finding Hawk's next forever home.

name: Patches
writeup:
Patches is a gentle, low-key pup who thrives in a calm, easygoing environment and prefers a soft place to relax over anything high-energy or hectic. His ideal day is simple and peaceful; sleeping in, enjoying a nice meal, heading out for a relaxed walk at his own pace, and then settling back into his favorite cozy spot for more rest. He isn't particularly interested in toys or rowdy play; instead, he's the kind of dog who brings a quiet, steady presence to the home.

On walks, Patches does very well in a harness and is happy to enjoy a couple mile stroll without rushing. In public, he tends to be polite and neutral with other dogs, offering a quick sniff before moving on, though he generally prefers to keep to himself; especially around overly energetic pups or busy, crowded environments. With new people, he can be a bit shy at first and appreciates a gentle, patient approach, but once he feels comfortable, he becomes an easy companion who likes to quietly follow his people and be part of the space without demanding attention.

Patches currently lives successfully with both cats and dogs and fits well in a multi-pet household, especially with calmer companions. He enjoys car rides, and is fine being left alone for reasonable periods. While he isn't especially snuggly, he does enjoy being near his people and sharing quiet company.

Overall, Patches' best quality is his sweet, steady temperament. He's quiet, well-mannered, and easy to live with, making him a comforting presence in the home. He would do best in a calm or moderately active household, ideally with another friendly dog and people who appreciate relaxed walks, low drama, and a loyal companion who simply enjoys being part of the family in his own gentle way.

Patches came from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after he was found as a stray.

name: Chocolate Chunk
writeup:
Meet Chocolate Chunk. Full of personality, confidence, and a whole lot of love to give. Chocolate Chunk AKA Churro, is a true chihuahua through and through. A tiny guy with a BIG personality! He is loyal, loving, hilarious, and will happily be your little shadow. His foster says he's a "manly man" with no fear, the cutest little ear flap, and a trot that will make you smile every single day.

This guy loves his people and is happiest when he's by your side. He enjoys walks, lounging in the sunshine, snuggling, and (of course) anything involving treats! He's a smart little guy who loves using his snuffle mat and is always ready for his next adventure.

This energetic little dude enjoys running and playing with his chihuahua foster sibling, and they have become the cutest pair; sharing beds, playing together, and figuring out how to share the best dog bed in the house.

Chocolate Chunk is also a fantastic little travel buddy! He does great in the car and rides relaxed and happy, ready to go wherever his person takes him.

Chocolate Chunk does best with someone who understands that he's a true chihuahua with a big heart and some big opinions. He can be selective with his dog friends and may need slow introductions with other pups. He's a little protective of his home space, but out and about he loves meeting people and does wonderfully at events. He's also been great with kids who respect his boundaries.

Chunk joined us after he landed at Contra Costa Animal Services as a stray. Due to the shelter's full status and his senior age, he was the perfect addition to the POMDR pack!

name: Romeo
writeup:
Meet Romeo - a sweet, happy, and lovable little guy whose tail never stops wagging! Whether he's out on a walk, lounging in the sunshine, playing with toys, or simply hanging out by your side, Romeo is always ready to share his joy. This friendly boy loves everyone he meets and greets people and dogs alike with a happy wagging tail. He's fantastic with other dogs of all sizes, and great with children. Romeo is the total package!

According to his foster, Romeo is the perfect mix of playful and easygoing. He loves long walks, hikes, car rides to adventures, backyard sunbathing, stuffed toys, squeaky toys, and hilarious blanket wrestling sessions. He can happily keep up on long outings, but he's also content to relax and nap the day away. He's house-trained, highly food motivated, and loves being involved in whatever his people are doing. Romeo is a loyal little companion who will happily follow you around the house and be your best buddy.

Romeo would thrive in a home where he can have plenty of companionship, whether that's with another friendly dog or a family member who enjoys having a devoted sidekick. A sunny yard would be a dream come true because soaking up the sunshine is one of his favorite activities! Sweet, silly, and endlessly affectionate, Romeo has a way of making everyone smile. His forever family is out there - could it be you?

Romeo joined POMDR from Contra Costa Animal Services after he was found as a stray.

name: Suki
writeup:
Suki's name comes from the Japanese word for loved one, and it fits her perfectly. This sweet girl has a gentle, mellow soul and a calm presence that makes you want to sit beside her and tell her everything will be okay.

Suki seems a little sad right now, understandably, as she's had to say goodbye to a life she once knew. She enjoys peaceful moments, cozy spots, and the simple comfort of kind company. What Suki wants most is a fresh start: a patient, loving home where she can feel safe, cherished, and truly chosen. With time and love, her heart is ready to bloom again.

Suki joined us from Hitchcock Road Animal Services after she was found as a stray.

Sponsored By: Cathleen and Marty Cohen

name: Hot Sauce
writeup:
Ready to add some zing to your life? Meet Hot Sauce! This spunky little guy is just as much fun as his name. With his fabulous jagged grin and flowing locks, he struts around like he owns the block, and honestly, he probably does.

Hot Sauce is the perfect mix of couch potato and nosy neighbor, always up for a reality TV binge, but equally committed to keeping tabs on every squirrel and delivery driver from his window post. A true foodie and belly rub connoisseur, he is also known for dramatic sighs if he thinks you are hogging the snacks. Hot Sauce had some issues with bladder stones upon intake but is doing so much better! He will need to stay on a special urinary diet for life to prevent future bladder stones.

Hot Sauce came to us from a Sacramento shelter needing medical care, and now he is ready to live his best, most pampered life.

Guess what? A secret admirer has already paid Hot Sauce's adoption fee! Now all he needs is a special someone to give him the loving home he deserves -- free of charge.

Sponsored By: Anonymous

name: Jamesy Boy
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Jamesy Boy is a tiny gentleman with a soft spirit and the sweetest gray muzzle. During the day, Jamsey will be your constant buddy. He loves to follow his foster parent around the house, but knows how to stay out of the way of your feet! He is a super cuddly boy who sleeps through the night and even does well when left home alone.

Despite his age, Jamesy Boy still has plenty of pep for a gentle walk and perks right up when treats or affection are on the menu. He is polite, easy to please, and grateful for every bit of kindness shown to him. This little guy has known some tough days, but his resilience and tenderness shine through every time he nudges your hand for pets. Jamesy will also gladly hang out in a pouch or sling and would love to go on adventures this way! Jamesy does excellently with other dogs, he is a respectful and confident member of the pack in his foster home!

Darling Jamesy Boy joined us from the Contra Costa Animal Shelter when they reached out for placement with a senior focused rescue.

name: Miss Marley
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Meet Miss Marley, the bravest little heart you'll ever love. Marley is a soft spirit with a story that shows just how resilient dogs can be. When she first arrived at the shelter, her nails were so overgrown they curled into her feet, a sign that she hadn't known proper care or comfort for far too long. It's believed she experienced some trauma or neglect in her past, and she carries a bit of understandable caution because of it. Despite all of this, Marley has blossomed and continues to do so.

Once she realizes she's safe, her whole face lights up, and she greets you with full body wiggles. She just asks for a little warm-up time and a kind, patient heart to help her feel secure. In return, she offers gentle companionship, quiet loyalty, and the sweetest little snuggles. Marley would prefer to be the only apple of someone's eye and may do best in an adult only home (or a home with patient and understanding older kids).

Marley joined us from Santa Cruz County Animal Services. She was adopted from there as a younger dog and surrendered back recently in concerning condition. Due to her age and clear traumas, they felt she would do best in the loving arms of a foster home while she waits for her forever family.

name: Walrus
writeup:
Aged to Perfection - $25 Adoption Fee - Walrus may hold senior status, but he's got more bounce than a beach ball at low tide! This perfect gentleman comes fully equipped with a wiggly butt, a happy trot, and the undeniable charm of a dog who hasn't quite realized he's technically a "senior." Walrus is a great walker, proudly strutting his stuff with pep in his step and joy in his jowls! Sadly, Walrus was diagnosed with Diabetes, but takes his daily injections like a champ! He would love an adopter with previous injection experience or simply a willingness to learn!

He's also wonderful with other dogs, getting along swimmingly with canine pals of all stripes. Friendly, upbeat, and full of good vibes, he's everyone's favorite flippered friend, just without the flippers. If you're looking for a sweet, silly, spry companion who's equal parts charm and cheer, Walrus is ready to lumber straight into your heart.

Walrus joined us from Silicon Valley Animal Care and Services where he was brought in as a stray. Due to his senior status, they felt he would do best in a senior focused rescue.
